author: Shiyera1
quote:
There's a Prologue in the Beginning of the Game were Player's have to Playthrough inorder to get to the Main gameplay & in the Prologue it's Unfortunately really Slow you mostly do a series of Fetch Quest & chores, 

The biggest downsides is that the Game Developers made some Changes to the some of the Core GTA series gameplay mechanics for GTA 6 unfortunately 

Significant changes to the traditional GTA vehicle-theft system:
Rockstar has made stealing certain vehicles more complicated.
some vehicles require tools that you might not have access to early in the story like,

In the Past GTA Game's besides 
just playing through missions, Player's could build an economic empire, purchase properties, collect income, and gradually expand what your character owned.

That added another reason to keep playing after completing the main storyline.

Unfortunately What Players can  actually own in GTA 6?

Personal garages that can be purchased around Leonida map.

Additional vehicle storage.

Garages with weapons lockers and storage for stolen goods.

Rockstar has also indicated that Jason and Lucia's safehouses are unlocked through the storyline rather than purchased independently. 

Players cannot Purchase or Own:

Nightclubs.
Drug Businesses 
Owning Strip Clubs.
Purchasing Restaurants.
Owning Car Dealerships.
Purchasing Commercial Properties.
Running Businesses for passive income.

GTA+ now offers optional in game single-player perks for $12.99 GTA 6 locks in-game content behind a subscription fee

Another downside is that the game is not even Running at a Locked 30fps Reports are coming out from other players that it's dipping & running at lower then that & Apparently the physics in the game is tied to the frames? Which probably explains why there's Bugs unfortunately 

I think they tried to focus too much on making a Real life Sim & New Game Engine Graphics for the New & Next Gen Console's, rather than continuing to build upon the gameplay freedom the previous GTA Games had established in the past, 

Because don't get me wrong the New Game Engine Graphics is nice 
& The Real life realism is okay but the GTA Series had more of a Fun Crime life realism & real life realism isn't necessarily an improvement if it makes the game less enjoyable.

author: Shiyera1
quote: Waited awhile to post this but I was highly disappointed with this sequel, the whole revenge plot that the director wanted to do for this game was poorly implemented and considering Last of Us Part 2 is a story driven game the plot was all over the place & didn't make any sense. While I enjoyed playing as Ellie & Abby but both Characters Overall Plot Was executed very messy & confusing and left me feeling very dissatisfied. I commend all the hard work put in to making this game from the Art & graphics even including the gameplay but I cannot complement the story aspects. I now understand why the previous Head team at Naughty Dog Development on the first Last Of Us didn't want to Do a Revenge plot on the first game. Why the New Head director choose to do the same for the sequel is beyond me. Unfortunately I cannot in good conscience recommend this game to anyone considering all the crunch culture the employees at Naughty Dog had to go through leading to people leaving the studio, even including all the people who were effected by the DMCA stike takedown & the threat of loosing their Channel on YouTube just for having a opinion on this game. While I hate to say it but I am making a hard choice and will not be looking forward to anything else coming from Naughty Dog Studio anymore, not untill the Studio takes a long look at what they need to do moving forward in order to make a good game.
